gross_amount_at_minimum.meaning: campaign creator supplies a gross amount exactly at the per-hour minimum so it passes rewardTokenMinAmounts validation

nonzero_protocol_fees.meaning: non-zero protocol fees apply to the campaign amount

net_amount_below_floor.meaning: the stored and distributed net amount per epoch falls below the guardian-configured rewardTokenMinAmounts floor
net_amount_below_floor.checkpoint: after fee subtraction, at storage/distribution of newCampaign.amount

recipients_underpaid.meaning: recipients are systematically underpaid relative to the whitelist floor and to what governance/guardian intended to enforce

claims.scope: Campaign creation: gross amount validated against rewardTokenMinAmounts, then fees subtracted to yield stored/distributed net amount

preconditions.text: The campaign creator supplies a gross amount exactly at the minimum per hour, so the gross amount passes the rewardTokenMinAmounts validation.; Non-zero protocol fees apply to the campaign amount.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A campaign's stored and distributed net amount per epoch should not fall below the guardian-configured rewardTokenMinAmounts floor.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Recipients are systematically underpaid relative to the whitelist floor and to what governance/guardian intended to enforce.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The scenario is conditional: it applies whenever creators choose the minimum valid gross amount and non-zero fees apply.
Campaign creator role is inferred from the report description; no explicit authorization statement is given.

limitations: The floor and net amount are represented as grounded Boolean observables because the report supplies no numeric fee or floor values.
Only the v_recipients_underpaid impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
